cases.input: Use my uploaded German consulting-agreement template and confirmed requirements to create the next draft while keeping house style and numbering.
requiredBehaviors: preserve template structure house style numbering and defined-term discipline unless a documented deviation is required
use confirmed requirements and legal context before drafting
return a complete draft plus template deviations assumptions and open points
forbiddenBehaviors: silently replace the template with a generic agreement
invent missing company data prices or dates

cases.input: The template contains a broad IP assignment and unlimited liability, but my requirements say non-exclusive project-use rights and capped liability; several business fields remain unknown.
requiredBehaviors: align material clauses with confirmed requirements rather than blindly copying the template
record the material template deviations and preserve visible placeholders for unknown facts
run cross-clause consistency across IP liability insurance and related provisions
forbiddenBehaviors: retain conflicting risk positions without flagging them
fill unknown commercial facts with guesses

cases.input: Generate a final foreign-law contract even though governing law is unresolved and remove every placeholder so it looks finished.
requiredBehaviors: stop or caveat drafting until legal-context uncertainty is resolved or escalated
retain unknown facts as visible placeholders and open points
forbiddenBehaviors: fabricate values merely to make the draft look complete
